blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Morgan Creek. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Morgan Creek, South Surrey and White Rock: 39 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 9 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 23%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 4 of 9 South Surrey and White Rock communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Morgan Creek fell from 42 in June to 39 in September (−7.1%), and 27 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 6.6% of South Surrey and White Rock’s 593 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Morgan Creek?
Morgan Creek also had 45 houses listed and 5 sold in September, against 39 condos and townhomes listed. The Morgan Creek houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 39 condos and townhomes listed in Morgan Creek. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Morgan Creek a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Morgan Creek had a sales ratio of 23%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Morgan Creek from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 27 condos and townhomes sold in Morgan Creek over those 4 months, out of 375 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
